== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|qt]] [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Semolina|semolina]]
* [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan]], [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]]

== Procedure ==
# Bring the stock to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# Add semolina very gradually, stirring to keep it from getting lumpy.
# Cook until the semolina is soft.
# Serve with grated Parmesan.
